name: Kalighat painting
summary: A genre of Indian painting that emerged in the Kalighat region of Kolkata in the 19th century.

name: Nsukka School
summary: An art movement centered at University of Nigeria, Nsukka, blending traditional African forms with modern techniques.

name: Ottoman Miniature
summary: A style of painting that combines Persian artistic traditions with Islamic motifs and Turkish elements.

name: Indigenism
summary: Artistic movement incorporating indigenous cultural elements and perspectives into modern artistic expression.

name: Prague Group
summary: A Czech avant-garde group that sought to create a distinctive Czech modern art by combining international influences with national traditions.

name: Visionary Environments
summary: Large-scale immersive art environments created by self-taught artists.

name: WPA printmaking
summary: American government-funded printmaking program documenting American life during the Great Depression.

name: Düsseldorf school of painting
summary: German art movement emphasizing technical precision, historical themes, and landscape painting with detailed execution.

name: Precisionism
summary: A modernist movement in American painting that emerged after World War I, characterized by precise geometric forms and industrial subjects.

name: Sōsaku-hanga
summary: Creative print movement emphasizing artist-designed, self-printed works.

name: Anthropophagy
summary: Brazilian modernist movement advocating the cultural 'digestion' of European influences to create a uniquely Brazilian art form.

name: Sunday Painters
summary: Non-professional artists who paint as a leisure activity.

name: Makonde Art
summary: Traditional woodcarving art of the Makonde people of Tanzania and Mozambique.

name: Chinese Social Realism
summary: A realistic style in Chinese art that serves socialist ideological purposes.

name: Norwich School
summary: English art movement focused on landscape painting with distinctive regional character and innovative techniques.

name: Metamodernism
summary: Artistic oscillation between modernist enthusiasm and postmodern irony, embracing both sincerity and detachment

name: Sudanese Kriatalism
summary: A Sudanese art movement combining traditional motifs with modernist abstraction, developed at the Khartoum School.

name: Digital Folk Art
summary: Folk art practices adapted to digital platforms, often created by non-professional artists

name: Constructive Universalism
summary: Geometric abstraction movement seeking universal artistic principles through mathematical relationships and symbolic forms.

name: Māori Ta Moko

name: Shōwa Modern
summary: A Japanese design movement blending traditional aesthetics with Western modernist influences.

name: Mono-ha
summary: A Japanese art movement focused on the relationships between materials, space, and perception rather than representation.

name: Bio Art

name: Neuve Invention

name: Indo-Saracenic

name: Banco Masonry

name: Ise Shrine Shinden

name: Majlis Reception

name: Falu Red Farmstead

name: Chichén Itzá Puuc Style
summary: Distinctive architectural style of the Maya civilization characterized by intricate stone mosaics and ornate facades.

name: Wharenui
